lane:
معذ

معذ 1 , [aor. ﹷ, inf. n. مَعَرٌ,] said of a man, (S,) and of the head, and of the tail, (TA,) _His_ or _its hair fell off;_ (S, TA;) as also ↓تمعّر, said of the head: (TA:) and the former said of the head, _its hair became little,_ or _scanty._ (TA:) and مَعِرَتْ, said of the forelock, (النَّاصِيَة, K,) or of that of a horse, (TA,) _it lost all its hair:_ (K:) and مَعِرَ, said of a solid hoof, _it lost the hair that hung down upon it from the fore part of the pastern._ (TA.) === مَعِرَ, (A, K,) aor. ﹷ, (K,) inf. n. مَعَرٌ, (S, TA,) said of hair, (S, A, K,) and of plumage, and the like, (K,) _It fell off;_ (S, A;) as also ↓تمعّر, said of hair: (S, A:) or _it became little,_ or _scanty;_ as also ↓أَمْعَرَ: (K:) and, said of a finger-nail, or toe-nail, ‡ _it came out,_ or _fell out,_ (A, K,) _in consequence of something befalling it,_ or _hurting it._ (K.) See مَعَرَّةٌ in art. عر. === [Hence,] مَعِرَ, (TA,) or مَعِرَ مِنْ مَالِهِ, (A,) ‡ _He became poor;_ (A, TA;) as also ↓أَمْعَرَ, (S, A,) inf. n. إِمْعَارٌ; (TA;) or the latter, _he became poor, and his travelling-provisions failed_ or _became exhausted;_ as also ↓معّر, inf. n. تَمْعِيرٌ. (K.) === [Hence also,] ↓أَمْعَرَتِالأَرْضُ ‡ _The land became destitute of herbage:_ or _its herbage became little,_ or _scanty:_ (K:) _contr. of_ أَمْرَعَت. (IKtt.)
